displayName: Strength Save: cost anomaly - Firestore reads per hour

documentation.content: Firestore document reads in the last hour exceeded 5000. Baseline 2026-08-31..09-30: median 40/h, p95 454/h, p99 900/h, max 2028/h. Typical cause: a client listener/query loop, a scheduled job scanning a growing collection, or an agent script reading production. Check Firestore Usage + Cloud Logging for the hour, then docs/COST-GUARDS.md.
